serverInfo.name: testudo
serverInfo.description: Automated risk-managed crypto trading platform with AI agent integration. Execute trades, analyze performance, and receive real-time alerts via REST + WebSocket.

tools.name: signal
tools.description: Submit a trade signal for execution through the risk engine. Supports shadow (paper) and live modes across CEX and Hyperliquid.

tools.name: journal_summary
tools.description: Fetch consolidated performance summary as JSON or LLM-optimized markdown with [T-xxxxxxxx] citation tokens.

tools.name: journal_insights
tools.description: Retrieve behavioral pattern detection from the weekly coach pipeline (sizing drift, frequency spikes, session anomalies, etc.).

tools.name: journal_compare
tools.description: Compare performance between two time periods with per-metric deltas and direction indicators.

tools.name: journal_entries
tools.description: Record trade theses, postmortems, and market observations in the journal.

tools.name: journal_tags
tools.description: Create strategy tags and apply them to trades for performance grouping.

streaming.name: execution_reports
streaming.description: Real-time fill confirmations, SL/TP placement, and trade lifecycle events.

streaming.name: risk_alerts
streaming.description: Real-time risk breach notifications (drawdown warnings, max positions, wallet expiry).
